summary: Current Pika Create pricing lists a $0 Free plan with 0 monthly credits (packs only), no watermark and no commercial license; it does not advertise renewable free generation credits. A separate official FAQ still says Basic (free) receives 150 credits/month and calls Pika 2.2 the latest model, suggesting older or legacy-product guidance. That conflict does not establish a current Create allowance or prove all Pika free generation has ended. Legacy/free account access remains to be verified. claim_steps: Open https://pika.art/pricing and check which Pika product and plan your account uses before expecting free generation.
For current Pika Create, the $0 Free plan lists 0 monthly credits and packs only; no renewable free generation allowance is advertised there.

The separate https://pika.art/faq says Basic (free) has 150 credits/month, but its older-model guidance conflicts with current Create pricing. Confirm legacy/account eligibility before relying on that allowance.
Check your actual account balance before generating. Buying a Create credit pack is paid usage and those credits do not work in the API, MCP, iOS app or old.pika.art.
